source: https://builtwith.com/ (inline <svg> in the header link a.navbar-brand[aria-label=BuiltWith])
edits: kept only subpath 0 (the 'b') of the one-path 'builtwith' header wordmark; dropped the 'uilt with' subpaths 1-10
fixed the viewBox attribute (the HTML parser had lowercased it to 'viewbox') and cropped it to the b with a 2% pad
light file: recoloured the white fill #fff to BuiltWith green #094303 (the colour of builtwith.com's apple-touch-icon / favicon / GitHub avatar), since white vanishes on the light tile
notes: Reviewer decision: BuiltWith has no separate symbol. Its own square icon (favicon, touch icon, GitHub avatar) is the two-line 'Built / With' wordmark in green; the only SVG of that is builtwith.com/img/safari-pinned-tab.svg, which is a potrace auto-trace ('Created by potrace 1.11'), so it was not used. The b shipped here is the first letter of BuiltWith's official vector wordmark, the same b the previous icon showed. If the 'b alone' is judged not to be BuiltWith's mark, the verdict becomes no-official-svg. Brand green #094303 is read from the PNG icons, not from an SVG.
license: BuiltWith brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with BuiltWith.
